JaxParks manages 34 outdoor swimming pools along with the Cecil Aquatic Center, an indoor
facility consisting of an Olympic-size pool and smaller exercise and training pools. Swim lessons,
aqua fitness classes, open swim and more are available to all Jacksonville residents. Outdoor pools
are open Memorial Day through Labor Day. The Cecil Aquatic Center is open year-round.

The Jacksonville Public Library maintains a collection of approximately 3 million items, including
books, audiobooks, e-books, compact discs, DVDs and videos. Internet service with wireless
computer access and Microsoft software is available on all public computers at all library
locations. Books are also available in large print at all locations. Please check your local library,
since quantities vary. Duval County residents, individuals who own property in Duval County,
students at a college located in Duval County, City of Jacksonville employees, Florida military
personnel and Duval County Public School teachers can obtain a free Jacksonville Public Library
card with proof of address and proper ID. For more information, all library numbers are
904-255-BOOK or log on to the library’s website at www.jaxpubliclibrary.org. Each library listing
is numbered and has a corresponding pinpoint on the map on page 27.

The AmeriCorps Seniors City of Jacksonville-Duval County Senior Companion
Program volunteers help seniors maintain independence either at a Senior
Center or in the client’s own home. Senior Companion volunteers typically
serve between 15 and 20 hours per week. Among other activities, they assist
with tasks of daily living and provide friendship and companionship.
Financial Benefit (Tax-Free Cost Reimbursement)
• $4.00 per hour stipend (Minimum of 15 hours per week)
• $4.00 per hour in-service training
• $2.50 daily meal allowance
• $.445/mile transportation reimbursement
• Accident and liability insurance
Criteria for Senior Companion Volunteers
• At least 55 years of age
• Complete 20 hours of In-Service Training
• Provide a minimum of 15 hours of service
per week
• Pass criminal background screenings (Level II
Background & National Sex)
